sources.title: Attention-Based RU-BiLSTM Sentiment Analysis Model for Roman Urdu - MDPI
sources.snippet: We propose an attention-based BiLSTM model called RU-BiLSM for the sentiment analysis of Roman Urdu. In order to evaluate the integrity of generated neural word embeddings, we experimented with six different arrangements of deep neural networks.

sources.title: Roman Urdu Sentiment Analysis: Traditional Approaches vs LLMs
sources.snippet: Large language models (LLMs) have greatly contributed to the advancement of sentiment analysis across different languages. However, their ability to outperform traditional approaches remains largely unexplored, at least for the cases of Roman Urdu, a commonly used informal script for Urdu. sources.title: Roman Urdu Sentiment Analysis Using Pre-trained DistilBERT and XLNet
sources.snippet: Roman Urdu is a resource-poor language, therefore training a deep learning-based model from scratch is not that fruitful due to the lack of a large dataset. This is where the magic of transfer learning comes to the rescue.
